descricao: Level XXX is a newly discovered level of the Backrooms, the extent of which has not been fully documented. Level XXX is a flat, wide-open plain covered in dried grass and a number of large, tilted stone pillars. Each pillar is a rough, grey, amorphous mass, suspended in the air out of conventional reach. Movement of these structures has yet to be observed. The level is dimly lit in a uniform dull, violet tint with no central light source. No day/night cycle has been observed and its sky is of an indeterminate colour. Level XXX has no other known structures.
